tagline.en_US: Organize links and integrations for homelab services behind a single dashboard. The project-maintained image stores its configuration under /config and runs without an external database or sidecar.

description.en_US: Organizr is an HTPC and homelab services organizer written in PHP. It provides a unified dashboard to organize and access different services through a single interface. Users and administrators can manage accounts and customize tabs directly within the application.
